corrected: 14017: description "...It mounts to the T-slot on one side and to an end tapped profile end on the other." -> restated without the unsupported one-side/other-side claim (page only lists T-slot and profile-end suggested hardware tables plus End Tap machining)
remaining_doubts: AF-TSM / AF-CSM: the Mount to T-Slot hardware row badged 15 (and 40) lists a metric bolt 11-8312 (M8 x 12mm BHSCS) with T-nut 3842 Roll-in Flex Handle; copied as printed, though a metric bolt for 15 series is unusual.

AF-TSM / AF-CSM: the P-badged F-A858 self drilling screw (For Added Security Anchor & Pipe) is kept in notes only, not suggested_hardware, since that row is P-only; the part itself is badged 15 and P.
AF-TSM / AF-CSM: specs key 'Weight (metric)' is not a printed column header; it holds the second (kg) line of the Weight cell.
14017: page 4-125 is a continuation; bullets and dimension drawing are on 4-124 (not in this chunk), so features and dimension letter meanings are absent.
Corner connector and pivot pages list Tap Profile End / End Tap machining with only a reference page (11-3) and no service number or series badge, so no machining_service parts were created.
